# TestScript for 20-modular-predictors
# Asserts nested subcommand grouping and the system + network
# modular domain types (shell script coverage lives in 19-shell-completion)

# 1. Normal command execution (system)
exec modular-predictors system kill --signal SIGTERM 1234
stdout '⚙  modular-predictors system kill'
stdout '<target>\s+system\.PID\s+1234\s+● cli'
stdout '-s, --signal\s+system\.Signal\s+SIGTERM\s+● cli --signal'
stdout 'Signaling PID 1234 with SIGTERM \(signal 15\)'

exec modular-predictors system service worker-daemon --pass-env PATH --env-var PATH
stdout '⚙  modular-predictors system service'
stdout '<name>\s+string\s+worker-daemon\s+● cli'
stdout '--pass-env\s+system\.EnvVar\s+PATH\s+● cli --pass-env'
stdout 'env PATH: set=true value='
stdout 'pass-env PATH='

# Account lookups read the system databases: root exists on POSIX systems and
# the root group is available on Linux.
[unix] exec modular-predictors system service worker-daemon --user root
[unix] stdout 'user: uid=0 gid=0'

[linux] exec modular-predictors system service worker-daemon --group root
[linux] stdout 'group: gid=0'

exec modular-predictors system inspect 5678
stdout '⚙  modular-predictors system inspect'
stdout '<pid>\s+system\.PID\s+5678\s+● cli'

# 2. Normal command execution (network)
exec modular-predictors network probe localhost --method GET --expect 200
stdout '⚙  modular-predictors network probe'
stdout '<host>\s+network\.Host\s+localhost\s+● cli'
stdout 'Probing localhost via GET \(expecting 200 OK\)'

# Interface lookup reads the system interface table (loopback exists on Linux)
[linux] exec modular-predictors network probe localhost --interface lo
[linux] stdout 'interface lo: mtu='
[linux] stdout 'interface lo addrs: [0-9]+'

exec modular-predictors network scan 127.0.0.1 --ports 80,443
stdout '⚙  modular-predictors network scan'
stdout '<host>\s+network\.Host\s+127\.0\.0\.1\s+● cli'
stdout '-p, --ports\s+\[\]network\.Port\s+\[80, 443\]\s+● cli --ports'

exec modular-predictors network serve --port 8080 --status 200 --content-type application/json
stdout '⚙  modular-predictors network serve'
stdout '-p, --port\s+network\.Port\s+8080\s+● cli --port'
stdout 'Mock responder would listen on port 8080 \(returning 200 OK, application/json\)'
stdout 'port privileged: false'
stdout 'status class: success=true client_error=false server_error=false'
stdout 'media: type=application subtype=json'

exec modular-predictors network serve --port 443 --status 404 --content-type text/html
stdout 'port privileged: true'
stdout 'status class: success=false client_error=true server_error=false'
stdout 'media: type=text subtype=html'

exec modular-predictors network serve --port 80 --status 500
stdout 'status class: success=false client_error=false server_error=true'

# 3. Shell completion scripts (bash/zsh smoke; 19-shell-completion owns the full sweep)
exec modular-predictors completion bash
stdout '_modular_predictors_completion'
stdout 'complete -o noquote -F _modular_predictors_completion modular-predictors'

exec modular-predictors completion zsh
stdout '#compdef modular-predictors'
stdout '_modular_predictors_completion'

# Aliases are not accepted, and invalid shells exit 2
exit-status 2 modular-predictors completion pwsh
stderr 'unknown shell "pwsh"'

exit-status 2 modular-predictors completion nu
stderr 'unknown shell "nu"'

exit-status 2 modular-predictors completion invalidshell
stderr 'unknown shell "invalidshell"'

# 4. Nested subcommand completion: group names, then group members
exec modular-predictors __complete export ''
stdout '"value":"system"'
stdout '"value":"network"'
stdout '"value":"completion"'

exec modular-predictors __complete export system ''
stdout '"value":"kill"'
stdout '"value":"service"'
stdout '"value":"inspect"'

exec modular-predictors __complete export network ''
stdout '"value":"probe"'
stdout '"value":"scan"'
stdout '"value":"serve"'

# 5. Built-in version manifest
exec modular-predictors version
stdout 'modular-predictors:'
stdout 'Version:\s+1\.0\.0'
stdout 'Go version:\s+go'

# 6. Dynamic completion - Kill Command Flags and Signals
exec modular-predictors __complete export system kill --
stdout '"value":"--signal"'
stdout '"value":"--process"'

exec modular-predictors __complete export system kill -
stdout '"value":"-s"'
stdout '"value":"-p"'

exec modular-predictors __complete export system kill --signal=
stdout '"value":"--signal=SIGTERM"'
stdout '"value":"--signal=SIGKILL"'
stdout '"value":"--signal=SIGINT"'
stdout '"tag":"signals"'

exec modular-predictors __complete export system kill --signal SIGK
stdout '"value":"SIGKILL"'

# 7. Dynamic completion - Service Flags (User, Group, EnvVar, Locale)
exec modular-predictors __complete export system service --locale=
stdout '"tag":"locales"'

exec modular-predictors __complete export system service --user=
stdout '"tag":"users"'

exec modular-predictors __complete export system service --group=
stdout '"tag":"user groups"'

exec modular-predictors __complete export system service --env-var=
stdout '"tag":"environment variables"'

# 8. Dynamic completion - Inspect Command (PIDs and Processes)
exec modular-predictors __complete export system inspect --process=
stdout '"tag":"processes"'

exec modular-predictors __complete export system inspect ''
stdout '"tag":"pids"'

# 9. Dynamic completion - HTTP Methods, Status Codes, Ports, MIME Types
exec modular-predictors __complete export network probe --method ''
stdout '"value":"GET"'
stdout '"value":"POST"'
stdout '"value":"PUT"'
stdout '"value":"DELETE"'

exec modular-predictors __complete export network probe --expect ''
stdout '"value":"200"'
stdout '"value":"404"'
stdout '"value":"500"'

exec modular-predictors __complete export network serve --port ''
stdout '"value":"80"'
stdout '"value":"443"'
stdout '"value":"8080"'
stdout '"value":"5432"'

exec modular-predictors __complete export network probe --content-type ''
stdout '"value":"application/json"'
stdout '"value":"text/html"'
